The '''Neshei sector''' was located in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region of<ref name="Outer" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Mondress sector/Legends|Mondress]] and [[Vardoss sector/Legends|Vardoss sectors]] [[spinward]], [[Hijoian Space/Legends|Hijoian Space]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], and the [[Carvandir sector/Legends|Carvandir]] and [[Sarla sector/Legends|Sarla sectors]] in the [[trailing]] direction. [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] formed the Expansion Region's boundary with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], neighboring the region's [[Jalor sector/Legends|Jalor]] and [[Outer Jalor sector/Legends|Outer Jalor sectors]].<ref name="Expansion" /> The Neshei sector retained those borders by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], by which [[Time/Legends|time]] it was situated within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

The Neshei sector contained the [[Neshei system/Legends|Neshei system]], which was situated on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Deadalis sector/Legends|Deadalis sector's]] [[Dorin system/Legends|Dorin system]] and the [[Vardoss system/Legends|Vardoss system]] of the Vardoss sector.<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neshei sector was established in<ref name="EGtW" /> the [[April 3]], [[2012]]<ref name="Penguin-Paperback">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/180097/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-star-wars-by-jason-fry-with-paul-r-urquhart/9780345477620|text=The Essential Guide to Warfare: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" /> On [[October 26]] of the same year, the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," a feature of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to<ref name="Expansion" /> the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> which placed it in grid squares J-7 and J-8.<ref name="Expansion" />
